title: Div
statementMd:
## Problem Statement

Two boys, A and B, will share $N$ indistinguishable sweets. How many ways are there to do this so that each boy gets a positive integer number of sweets?

## Constraints

- $N$ is an integer.
- $1 \leq N \leq 15$

## Input

Input is given from Standard Input in the following format:

```
N
```

## Output

Print the answer as an integer.
statementZhMd:
## 题目描述

两个男孩 A 和 B 将分享 $N$ 颗完全相同的糖果。要使每个男孩都分到正整数颗糖果，共有多少种分法？

## 约束条件

- $N$ 是一个整数。
- $1 \leq N \leq 15$

## 输入格式

输入从标准输入按以下格式给出：

```
N
```

## 输出格式

以整数形式输出答案。

samples.note: There is only one way to share the sweets: A and B get one sweet each.
